# engine-project

Two one-clip reels built by the motion engine in `skill/kinotta/engine/`. Their `v1/index.html` is not
committed: tests build it from the skill's examples with `buildEngineProject` (`tests/helpers/engine.ts`),
so each reel always shows what the current engine builds.

- `opus-drop`: `examples/opus-aoe2/01-opus-drop.html`.
- `effort-slider`: `examples/opus-aoe2/03-effort-slider.html`, whose castle sits in a named wrapper with
  no box of its own.
